stations.name: What it covers
stations.meaning: Which hazard, which asset, which parts; what is left out
stations.paragraph: Hurricane wind on wind farms: published fitted expected-damage curves for generic steel turbine towers (Wind Energy, 2020) used as published; the 3.3 MW / 100 m curve stands in for the canonical 5 MW turbine, tower value only. It names 1 part: Turbine tower. Outside its scope: storm surge, flood, scour, debris, rain ingress, lightning and fire and business interruption. Kinds of damage it does not include: blade and other non-tower turbine failure modes (the curve is driven by tower damage states only).

stations.name: What breaks
stations.meaning: The parts of the plant the hazard damages, each with its own curve
stations.paragraph: For this hazard the wind farm is split into 1 part: Turbine tower. 9 further units are named but withheld — wt turbine equipment assembly, wt foundation, wt pad mounted electrical, wt collection system, wt gsu substation, wt control building and scada, wt civil infra, support fieldwork and support transport logistics — a stated 'not zero', not a curve. Parts of the plant's value with no curve yet: rotor, nacelle, foundation, pad electrical, collection, GSU/substation, control building and SCADA, civil, fieldwork and transport (withheld, not zero).

stations.name: How damage is measured
stations.meaning: The hazard intensity on the x-axis and the shape of the curve
stations.paragraph: Damage is read against peak 3-second gust at 10 m (km/h). The curve is nothing below a threshold, then a Weibull-shaped rise (thresholded Weibull). The input, in the catalogue's words: peak 3-second gust at 10 m (km/h); zero at or below 90, evaluated 108 to 252; for the canonical 5 MW proxy 90 to 108 returns zero and above 252 returns the maximum (both flagged).

stations.name: Where the numbers come from
stations.meaning: The sources, what was taken from each, and how sure we are
stations.paragraph: 4 sources set this cell: Probabilistic risk assessment on wind turbine towers subjected to cyclone-induced wind loads, Wind Energy 23(3), 528-546 (2020) (JAIMES_2020_TC_WIND_TURBINE / TCWW-S005), Canonical wind-farm reference profile: 20 x 5 MW, $140M, tower share 0.16, Owner scope correction authorizing the tower-only 0.16 binding (OWNER_SCOPE_CORRECTION_2026_08_14; governance, not evidence) and Hazard hurricane wind-farm EAL review that found the 0.63 value mismatch. Of the 6 parameters, 2 are transferred (T3) and 4 are our judgment (T4). The source and claim registers are machine-readable files in the cell folder. 4 sources have no link in the register.

stations.name: What it is worth
stations.meaning: The share of the plant's value the curves cover
stations.paragraph: 16 % of the project's value has a curve. No curve yet for rotor, nacelle, foundation, pad electrical, collection, GSU/substation, control building and SCADA, civil, fieldwork and transport (withheld, not zero) (84 % of the value).

stations.name: The audit
stations.meaning: The seven checks a curve passes before release
stations.paragraph: No seven-step audit was found as a file or as a section of the dossier. That is a finding, not an omission of the page. A site-condition adapter has not been written for this cell.

stations.name: The files
stations.meaning: The runtime file, the write-up and the workbook
stations.paragraph: The runtime file is the curve artifact with 4 curve records (model v1.2, docs r2). The write-up is tropical_cyclone_wind_wind_curve_derivation_dossier__model_v1_2__docs_r2.md. The workbook is damage_curve_records_tropical_cyclone_wind_wind__model_v1_2__docs_r2.xlsx. The cell folder holds 16 files, each with its SHA under Details.

stations.name: What it can output
stations.meaning: What a consumer may compute with this curve
stations.paragraph: One hurricane wind event, a dollar scenario, yearly loss and PML, VaR and TVaR are available only under conditions the consumer (Hazard) checks. Annual metrics belong to the consumer; nothing here is an expected annual loss.

stations.name: How it was tested
stations.meaning: The known answers this build reproduced
stations.paragraph: This build reproduced 39 of 39 known answers through the cell's evaluator (within 1e-12 on the damage ratio). The validation record says report. 1 outside check: Financial range check (Hazard repo): tower-value ceiling for wind-farm hurricane loss (shared lineage; no open industry loss figures found).
